Photograph of the white-border [[Reflection (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The linked source retains the whole obtained photograph; its photographer is not identified. The source photograph is tightly framed; some outer white edges or corners are not wholly visible. Those edges have not been reconstructed.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/VZsAAOSwWLlgtcL2/s-l1600.webp complete source photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (0, 0)–(1200, 1600) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive and downsampled using Lanczos resampling to 350 × 467 pixels, then saved as PNG. Printed words, art, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop, not a facsimile. Photograph or acquisition dates do not establish first publication.
